Prestigious universities, including MIT and the University of Cambridge, integrate our material into their curricula. Help usÂ take online education to new heightsÂ andÂ make a meaningful impact on humankind.

At IxDF, weâre not just a company but a movement dedicated to making high-quality design and AI education accessible to everyone, everywhere.

We've pioneered online design education since 2002. We have over 1,150,000 enrollments and 1,583 company members, with more than 40 courses, 160 Master Classes, and thousands of open-source design resources, created by our team in collaboration with 240 industry leaders.

With learners from over 100 countries, your work will empower people worldwide.

We're Hiring Three People for Our Editorial Team

We're growing, and three roles are open at the same time to build the next generation of our core educational product. Here's what each role leads on:

  • Our Course Writers and Editors:Â lead how our courses and articles read. You make each title engaging, ensure each sentence flows, and edit the written course experience from the userâs perspective.Â This is the role described here.

  • Our Education Designers, UX, UI, and AI:Â lead how design and AI are taught. You plan, structure, and create the core content, and you decide what a course participant should be able to do by the end and how they get there.

  • Our Course Directors, UX, UI, and AI:Â lead what we teach and who teaches our courses and Master Classes. You reach out to industry leaders and create the invitation they say yes to. You bring your judgment to a planned course outline: what's missing, what doesn't belong, and whether the structure is solid. You plan and shoot courses with our Education Designers.

Weâre a flexible team, and youâll be able to do what you excel in. Everyone on our team creates courses, and everyone works across these roles. If you're torn between two roles, apply for the one you'd be best at, and tell us in your application which other one you considered and why.

You, the Course Writer and Editor, own how our courses and Master Classes read: the scripts, hooks, headings, on-screen text in videos, quiz wording, and editorial voice across everything we publish. OurÂ Education DesignersÂ hand you the structure and the exercises, and they'll often hand you draft headings and hooks along with them. The final wording is yours. You'll work closely with ourÂ Co-Founder, your Team Lead, the Education Designers, and the Course Directors, and you'll have a real say in what we make. You'll also work closely with the video team and our growth team.

Your Role at IxDF

  • Be a core part of our Editorial Team.Â You'll collaborate with IxDF editors, video editors, and UX and UI designers as well as external industry leaders toÂ create educational content for people worldwide. You'll help them succeed in the age of AI with skills inÂ timeless, human-centered design and AI.

  • Make an impact as you decide how every course sounds.Â The title people want to click, the first paragraph that hooks them, the on-screen words that make our learners remember and apply what our experts teach. Our Education Designers create the structure and draft the headings, hooks, and quizzes. You finalize the scripts, hooks, headings, quiz wording, and editorial voice across everything we publish, and you give proactive feedback on the structure.

  • You don't need a design background.Â Most of our writers and editors start without one, and that can be an advantage because you're coming to design the way many of our learners do. In your first year you'll learn it from the inside, working through it sentence by sentence with the people who teach it, until you know what a course participant needs.

  • Write for a diverse, global audience.Â Some of our courses and Master Classes serve experienced designers who want to grow into more senior work. Others serve people moving into design from other fields, and many are not reading in their first language. Often, you'll write for all of them at the same time. Getting that balance right without watering anything down is a rewarding editorial challenge.

  • Be the voice of IxDF.Â Our reputation lives in every sentence we publish, and many of those sentences will be yours.Â Represent a global movement dedicated to design education, and take pride in it. It's a big responsibility, and a rewarding one.

  • Set and raise the standard for our assessments, so a correct answer proves understanding, not just recognition, and a good question teaches as well as tests. Our Education Designers decide what a question has to test. You write the wording that does both.

  • Balance the big picture with the smaller details.Â Expect to focus on one large course creation project per month, alongside small, continuous improvements to what's already published. You'll also write and edit articles, course descriptions, and supporting material, and help our Growth team and our two founders get the voice right in campaigns and social copy.

  • Turn expert material into lessons.Â Once you've built an understanding of design, you'll take a one-hour Master Class transcript and the learning goals for what the lesson must teach, then turn the strongest sections into a finished lesson. We produce 3 Master Classes per month, so new expert material arrives continuously.

  • Our coursesÂ combine written and video lessons.Â You'll work closely with the video team, givingÂ constructive feedbackÂ on on-screen text, b-roll, graphics, and animation, and telling them which takeaways need a visual, so each video is more engaging to learn from.

  • Find room for improvementÂ by looking at completion rates, learner feedback, and the portfolios learners produce, then go back and fix what isn't excellent yet. Small, incremental edits are why our material surpasses even the very best in industry and academia.Â We're always learning, always improving, always raising the barÂ in everything we do.

  • Weâre committed toâ¯excellence, and we seek a like-minded enthusiast to join us. This role isâ¯not for the average. Ahead of you is aâ¯highly rewarding and enriching journey.

  • Maintain and improve ourÂ crystal-clear documentationÂ so our knowledge resources stay up-to-date, easy to find, and provide instant value to our internal teams. Clarity is key. Any line of documentation should be self-explanatory.

  • You won't do this alone.Â You'll work with our Education Designers, Course Directors, your Team Lead, and our Co-Founder to pressure-test the material: you'll add what's missing, delete what's redundant, and suggest how to improve the structure. You'll be working with people who have anything from 4 to 40 years of design experience, ready to share their knowledge. We'll also help you upskill so you can grow a designer's eye alongside your editor's ear. You'll work in a diverse, highly organized, result-driven environment where you'll developÂ personally and professionally.

  • We're proud to have assembled aÂ remarkable team of unicornsÂ who uplift, motivate, and push each other to excel daily. There's a seat open for someone who shares our passion for excellence. Could that be you?

Do You Share IxDF's Vision?

People don't just buy our courses; they invest in a better version of themselves and a career they truly love. That's why every course we create and every sentence we write must do more than just inform. It must reflect the high-quality research and hands-on skills we teach.

  • Show the dream outcome: Help people imagine a future of creative, meaningful work, fulfillment, and impact through a career in design and AI.

  • Strengthen belief in success: Build confidence through real stories, practical case studies, and hands-on templates.

  • Overcome barriers: Write in a way that's crystal clear, human, and motivating. Connect and lead the way.

You'll educate, inspire, energize, and support. Whether you write a course article or give editorial feedback on a video, you'll help designers thrive in the age of AI.

About You

  • You have at least 4 years of professional writing or editing experience.

  • What matters far more than the number is the quality of the work you can show us: a course, an article series, a set of scripts, documentation, a newsletter. Weâre excited to hear what it was, why you wrote it the way you did, and how long it took you to create.

  • You're aÂ master communicatorÂ with aÂ sharp eye for detailÂ andÂ strong skills in language, tone, and flow.

  • You can take a complex idea and write it so a beginner gets it on the first read.

  • You know how to hook someone with a title and a first line, and you know the difference betweenÂ a hook that's earnedÂ and a hook that's cheap.

  • YouÂ collaborate with AI in everything you do. You use AI to write, research, and create faster, and you know how to takeÂ human leadership, soÂ the outcome is 100% yoursÂ and better than you could have created without AI.

  • Youâre eager to help people build UX and UI skills because you know theyâre more relevant than ever in the age of AI.

  • You can write for a career changer and for an experienced designer without losing either one.

  • You have anÂ exceptional talent for creating structure, and you take pride in organizing processes and tasks in a way that's efficient and clear.

  • You're genuinelyÂ curiousÂ about UX and UI design, and you're motivated to learn how great design shapes experiences and solves problems.

  • You're genuinelyÂ curiousÂ about how AI is changing design work and design education, and you look for new ways to use it in your own work.

  • You're kind, and you have theÂ social intelligence and empathyÂ to engage well with very different kinds of people.

  • You're fluent in written and spoken English, your grammar is exact, and you understand the power of tone, brevity, and microcopy.

  • You takeÂ full ownershipÂ of your work and see it through. You move comfortably across ad hoc projects of varying complexity, and you stay consistent when the work turns repetitive.

  • Youâre enthusiastic about learning by doing and areÂ committed to putting in the effort to continuously improve your skills.

  • YouÂ spot problemsÂ before anyone else notices them, and when something goes off track you come back with a solution rather than a report.

  • YouÂ value teamwork, prioritize collaboration, and focus on collective goals and harmony in the workplace.

  • You work well with great responsibility and freedom inside a well-documented, structured system. Accuracy and attention to detail are key on an online learning platform, where every tag must be correct and every piece of text formatted to our upload system. It's in your nature to meticulously double-check that everything is in order.

  • You'reÂ self-motivated, and you loveÂ creative freedom,Â independent judgment, and theÂ responsibilityÂ that comes with both.

  • Youâre driven by the desire toÂ make a positive impact in the worldÂ and to improve the lives of others.

  • You're located in aÂ time zoneÂ between UTC+0 (London) and UTC+4 (Dubai), which covers Europe, the Middle East, and Africa.

Bonus Points

None of these are required, but each of them would make us even happier.

  • You'veÂ taught in classrooms or workshops, orÂ you've created educational material.

  • You have yourÂ own blog or social media pageÂ where you create and share original content.

  • YouâveÂ collaborated with video production teams.

  • You've writtenÂ quiz or assessment questions.

  • You've worked with anÂ LMS or an online learning platform.

  • You hold aÂ bachelor's or master'sÂ degree in communications, journalism, literature, or a similar field.

What We Can Offer

  • A highly valued role:Â You'll shape our core product, our courses and Master Classes.

  • Reach and impactÂ that are difficult to find anywhere else in this field. Your words will be read year after year, by hundreds of thousands of people who build better careers and design a better world for all of us.Â An education you can't buy:Â free access to every IxDF course and Master Class, and a job that requires you to study the work of the best designers alive in order to edit it. Most people pay for this. You'll be paid for it.

  • Access:Â the designers whose books you'd normally buy are the people whose words you'll be shaping, and in some cases the people you'll be in a studio with.

  • Studio shoots:Â once you know our courses well, usually after your first year, you'll be a real asset on a studio production, and you'll be welcome to join us when we meet our experts in professional studios around the world. Some of us love that part and go every time; others keep travel to a minimum. Both work for us. On average we shoot 4-6 new courses per year.

  • Autonomy:Â Nobody will ever hand you a template and tell you to fill it in. You decide how our courses read.

  • A global, purpose-driven team: Work remotelyÂ alongside passionate professionals from all over the world, united by aÂ common missionÂ to create the best possible design and AI education in the world and make it accessible for everyone.

  • Our co-founder and co-CEO, Rikke, will work closely with you. She and our other co-founder, Mads, built IxDF from nothing, with no investment capital, so we would stay free to make world-class design education affordable to everyone. She was the sole editor and video editor for many of our early years, so she's shaped our course planning, expert interviews, video shoots, and content editing from the inside. She's still hands-on in everything we do, and she still films educational videos herself, in places like the US, the North Pole, and Nepal.

  • AÂ full-time positionÂ within a fully remote organization. Video-based collaboration with your colleagues from elsewhere on the planet, and we get together in person each year, on a team trip or a studio production.

  • Bi-weeklyÂ knowledge-sharing sessionsÂ and 4 meeting-free days weekly for focused work.

  • A work culture with noÂ fluffy titles, political agendas, orÂ corporate drama. Your colleagues valueÂ your warm character, your strong work ethic, and the results you deliver. If you embody old-school virtues of always striving to deliver results, learn and become better every day, you'll thrive at IxDF.

  • A daily mission to help impact,Â empower, and enrich the lives of millions of peopleÂ by creatingÂ affordable high-end design educationÂ for everyone across the planet. It'll be yours too.

  • A companyÂ where the distance between idea and execution is minimal.Â We're a highly agile organization withÂ zero bureaucracy or corporate politicsÂ â and withÂ exceptional order and efficiency.

  • A company culture whereÂ passion meets high performance and excellence. To help us improve the world, and yourself in the process,Â you'll need grit, strong work ethic, long-term thinking, and self-discipline.

  • We thrive because we have aÂ hands-on attitude and a bias towards actionÂ as opposed to fluff-filled, unrealistic strategies. You'll needÂ crisp execution skills yourselfÂ and the ability toÂ impress your colleagues with concrete results, just like they'll impress you.

  • If you want even more opportunities to show the world what you can do, youâre in luck! When you're willing to do the hard work of learning and growing, then youâll find virtuallyÂ limitless opportunities with us.

  • We built online design education before people believed in it. AI is now changing what designers do, and they carry a bigger responsibility than ever. You'll be at theÂ forefront of teaching designers to work with AI and to design responsibly for it. You'll helpÂ set a direction that shapes both the designers we teach and the people who use what they build. Together, we'll design a better world.Â

title: Lead Estimator
description:
About the role

For more than 60 years, Complex has been known for delivering award winning construction projects across the built environment.


Our skillful execution of quality projects is an expression of our personal and professional commitment to connecting and enhancing communities.


We are looking for a Lead Estimator, this role will provide support and technical advice to our estimating team, deliver accurate, competitive, and well-documented cost estimates for civil & construction projects, while also providing oversight and tender coordination to the estimating team.


The Lead Estimator is a critical role that remains hands-on in the preparation of tenders while contributing to pricing strategy, subcontractor engagement, and achieving tendering milestones.


Key responsibilities

  • Prepare accurate and competitive cost estimates, budgets, and scopes of work for civil construction tenders
  • Review tender documentation (drawings, specifications, RFTs, contracts) to confirm scope, risks, and opportunities
  • Conduct and/or coordinate site inspections to assess conditions and identify construction risks
  • Perform and review quantity take-offs using Benchmark, Revu, and Excel
  • Prepare detailed cost build-ups, subcontractor comparisons, and pricing reconciliations
  • Analyse historical project data to support pricing accuracy and continuous improvement
  • Promote consistent estimating methodologies, tools, and documentation standards
  • Maintain effective working relationships with key subcontractors and suppliers

About you

  • Minimum 5 years' experience in commercial construction / civil infrastructure estimating
  • Demonstrated experience preparing and leading complex civil tenders
  • Strong understanding of civil, building and construction methodologies, contract review and risk identification, and cost planning and pricing strategy
  • Proven ability to mentor and support junior and mid-level estimators
  • High-level competency in Benchmark, Bluebeam Revu, Microsoft Excel, and Microsoft Project (Intermediate level)
  • Ability to manage multiple tenders and competing deadlines
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Well-developed interpersonal, negotiation, and organisational skills


If this sounds like you please APPLY reach out to Ebony Ison, ebony.ison@complexco.com.au

Summary

The position encompasses functions such as ramp and cargo handling services, driving and operating ramp vehicles and ground service equipment and interior aircraft cleaning to the highest standard while complying with State, Airport and Swissport Standard Operating Procedures and Policies.

Your profile

title: Renewables Project Scheduler
description:
Apply

Description

Job Summary:

The BESS Project Scheduler is responsible for developing, maintaining, and analyzing detailed project schedules for Battery Energy Storage System (BESS) projects. This role plays a critical part in ensuring projects are delivered on time by providing accurate schedule forecasts, identifying risks, and supporting project teams with data-driven insights across engineering, procurement, construction, commissioning, and energization phases. This role requires a strong leader that will take ownership of driving accurate and up to date scheduling across multiple projects as well as taking initiative to drive process improvements where there is an opportunity to improve.

Job Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain integrated project schedules for BESS projects from NTP through COD
  • Build schedules covering engineering, procurement, manufacturing, logistics, civil, electrical, installation, commissioning, and grid interconnection
  • Collaborate with Project Managers, Construction Managers, OEMs, and subcontractors to validate logic, durations, and sequencing
  • Perform critical path analysis, float analysis, and schedule risk assessments
  • Track project progress and update schedules using actuals, forecasts, and recovery plans
  • Identify schedule impacts related to procurement delays, permitting, weather, interconnection, or change orders
  • Prepare schedule narratives, look-ahead schedules, and progress reports for internal and external stakeholders
  • Support claims, change management, and time-impact analyses as required
  • Ensure schedules align with contract milestones, EPC agreements, and owner requirements
  • Maintain schedule standards, templates, and best practices across the portfolio
  • Other duties as assigned

Requirements

  • Bachelorâs degree in construction management, Engineering, Project Management, or related field (or equivalent experience)
  • 5+ years of project scheduling experience in utility-scale energy, power generation, or heavy civil construction
  • Direct experience supporting BESS, solar, wind, or substation projects
  • Advanced proficiency in Primavera P6 (required)
  • Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Project and Excel
  • Strong understanding of construction sequencing, procurement lead times, and commissioning activities

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with EPC contracts and utility-scale energy storage projects
  • Knowledge of battery OEM workflows (manufacturing, FAT, shipping, commissioning)
  • Familiarity with Power BI or other reporting/analytics tools
  • Experience supporting schedule recovery plans and delay analysis
  • Experience developing resource-loaded and cost-loaded schedules
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to present schedule data clearly to non-technical stakeholders

Work Environment/Physical Requirements

  • Combination of office, remote, and active construction site environments
  • Ability to work extended hours during critical project phases
  • Working in all weather conditions
  • Must be able to lift more than 50 lbs.
  • May require overtime, nights, or weekends based on project needs

Pre-Employment Requirements

Candidates must successfully complete a background check and drug screening prior to hiring. This role is considered safety-sensitive and may be subject to ongoing drug and testing in compliance with company policy and regulatory requirements.

Location: Location specific; travel up to 50%

TAKKION is an Equal Opportunity Employer

Salary Description

$90,000-$130,000

title: Butcher
description:
Company Overview


The Butcher Shoppe (TBS) is one of the largest meat processors in Ontario located in the Toronto area. Our meats are carefully selected for quality and consistency to achieve the highest standards for our customers. Through the timely heritage of artisanal butchery, over 100,000 lbs of meat are processed daily and fulfilled by a team of butchers who convert fresh meat to custom specifications. Our distribution network uses a fleet 45 company trucks that make over 1,000 deliveries every day to customers across Ontario including premier hotels, casinos, event venues, restaurants, and foodservice establishments. TBS also manages a complex supply chain that spans 4 continents. Our people-first philosophy has provided a strong foundation for growth. This has allowed us to expand while still staying true to our heritage of artisanal butchery. Over the past 40 years, we have grown steadily to meet the demands of the foodservice industry and now, direct-to-consumer through e-commerce and a full-service onsite Retail store.

description:

Was wir suchen, ist jemand, der das zuverlässig umsetzt und am Laufen hält – Beiträge und Stories erstellen, täglich neue Accounts ansprechen, alles sauber dokumentieren.
Du bekommst also keine leere Seite, sondern eine Grundlage, mit der du sofort loslegen kannst. Und wenn du eigene Ideen hast, wie wir Content oder Outreach besser machen können: sehr gerne – wir sind offen dafür und probieren gemeinsam aus.

description:
Super44 is building the all-in-one AI platform for independent local businesses: cafés, pubs, restaurants, flower shops and boutiques. We are a small, pre-seed team working together in person from a house overlooking the Rhine in Bonn. We are hiring a Founding Creative Growth Lead to build an unmistakably human social presence and turn great stories into growth.

Tasks

Own Super44’s social strategy, brand voice and creative output.

Find the human stories inside independent businesses and tell them brilliantly.

Develop concepts, write, shoot, direct, edit and publish the work yourself.

Make merchants, customers and founders compelling on camera.

Build authentic UGC and creator formats.

Test platforms, formats, hooks and narratives quickly.

Study performance, iterate, and turn organic winners into paid campaigns.

Use the latest AI tools to elevate real footage without making it generic.

Over time, build and direct a creative team while remaining close to the work.

Requirements

You have exceptional taste, strong internet culture instincts and a portfolio that proves it.

You have personally made social or video work that performed — you did not only write the strategy or brief someone else.

You can find a story, make people comfortable on camera, shoot it, edit it and learn from the result.

You care about brand and feeling, but also understand performance, paid social and why creative works.

You use AI tools fluently without letting them flatten the work.

You are fluent in German and English.

You enjoy spending time inside local businesses and can earn an owner’s trust.

Most importantly, you love independent hospitality and want to help local businesses thrive.

Benefits

€65,000–€125,000 salary plus 0.4%–1% equity.

Unusual ownership in a founding role.

Direct influence on the brand, product and company from the beginning.

Real merchants, strong early traction and a pre-seed round already raised.

The opportunity to create category-defining work and eventually build the creative team.

An ambitious, high-intensity, in-person environment in Bonn with a team that takes health, trust and good intent seriously.

To apply, send us three pieces of work you are proud of. For each, explain your personal contribution, why you made it that way and what happened after it went live. Then tell us about an independent hospitality business you love and the first Super44 story you would create there.

title: Marketing & Content Intern (Mandatory Internship / Pflichtpraktikum)
description:
Most people don’t get real ownership until they’re years into their career. You’d get it in month one.

Cloud Studios is an independent product studio in Berlin. We turn sharp insights into digital products people need, then build the strongest ones - and the brands behind them - into independent companies.

Right now, we’re building across AI, consumer products and services, with our biggest current focus on a service helping brands understand and improve how they show up in AI recommendations.

You’d be building the media presence behind all of it, starting with the founder’s own.

This isn’t a “post more content” internship. You’ll take what’s actually happening inside the company - a product decision, client work, a raw idea, something we learned and turn it into content sharp enough to make someone stop scrolling.

You’ll work directly with the founder and have real influence over what we create, what gets published and how our content evolves.

Tasks

  • Grow the presence of the founder (Eli) and our brands, primarily across LinkedIn and Instagram
  • Create content across formats: posts, carousels, short-form video and more
  • Turn raw ideas, conversations and product updates into content worth watching or reading
  • Build a content waterfall system that turns one strong idea into multiple formats and channels
  • Shoot and edit short-form and behind-the-scenes content with the founder and team
  • Design visual content using Figma or Canva
  • Develop and improve our content templates and visual systems
  • Track what performs, kill what doesn’t and continuously test new ideas
  • Help turn attention into actual leads and business opportunities

Requirements

  • You are currently enrolled at a university and the internship can be recognised as a mandatory internship (Pflichtpraktikum) within your degree
  • Strong written and spoken English
  • You understand how LinkedIn and Instagram actually work
  • You can take a rough idea and turn it into something clear and engaging
  • You have good visual instincts and are comfortable using Figma or Canva
  • You’re proactive, reliable and comfortable taking ownership
  • You’re curious about AI, startups, brands and new tools
  • You care about the quality of what you put out

No years of marketing experience required. We care more about taste, initiative and whether you can turn ideas into finished work

Benefits

  • Real ownership from day one - not busywork!!!
  • Work directly with the founder and have a genuine say in what we build
  • Create content that actually gets published and impacts the business
  • Learn how founder-led marketing, content and lead generation work in practice
  • Build a content system around real products and customer work
  • Exposure to product, sales, growth and AI across multiple brands
  • Freedom to experiment with formats, tools and ideas
  • Build tangible work you can point to afterwards
  • Strong performance can create a serious path towards a longer-term paid role as the studio grows. This is your opportunity to take!
  • Hybrid work in Berlin (minimum 2 days in the Office, ideally more)
  • Flexible 20–40 hours/week, with full-time preferred

Skip the generic cover letter. We won’t read it.

We’d rather understand how you think and what you have good taste in.

Send us your answers for a few short questions below. Most importantly,if you have a portfolio, or something you’ve created that you’re genuinely proud of, we’d love to see it.

Important: This is an unpaid mandatory internship (Pflichtpraktikum). You must currently be enrolled at a university that can recognise the placement as a mandatory part of your degree, and be have the required visa status to work/intern in Germany.

description:
IHR START BEI PRAXISEINS.

Sie haben Medizin studiert, um Patienten zu behandeln und nicht um Formulare auszufüllen, KV-Anfragen zu beantworten und IT-Ausfälle zu managen? Bei PraxisEins haben Sie ein Team hinter sich, das sich darum kümmert. Damit Sie wieder das tun können, wofür Sie angetreten sind – ganz ohne Nacht- und Wochenenddienste.

Für unser modernes Hausarztzentrum suchen wir ab sofort einen Facharzt für Allgemeinmedizin und/oder Innere Medizin (m/w/d).

Als inhabergeführter und staatlich unterstützter Gesundheitsversorger hat PraxisEins es sich zum Ziel gemacht, die hausärztliche Versorgung zu sichern und dabei Qualitätsmedizin zu ermöglichen!

In unseren modernen Hausarztzentren können Sie sich ganz auf die Medizin konzentrieren. Wir legen Wert auf moderne Diagnostik, digitalisierte Abläufe, ärztliche Fortbildung, ein gutes Teamgefüge und ärztlichen Austausch im Team.

WAS WIR IHNEN BIETEN:

  • Medizin im Mittelpunkt: Sie fokussieren sich auf die Behandlung Ihrer Patienten – den Rest übernehmen wir!

  • Qualitätsmedizin: Unsere Standorte verfügen über modernste Diagnostik und digitalisierte Praxisabläufe; ein kollegialer Austausch ist uns wichtig

  • Attraktive Vergütung und Aufstiegsmöglichkeiten: Sie erhalten ein übertarifliches Gehalt - bei sehr guter Leistung bietet sich in unserer Gruppe die Möglichkeit des Aufstiegs zur ärztlichen Leitung mit einem attraktiven Partnerschaftsmodell

  • Strukturierte Fortbildung: Mit den organisierten Qualitätszirkeln unserer PraxisEins-Akademie bieten wir Ihnen leitlinienkonforme interne Fortbildungen

  • Lebenslanges Lernen: Fortbildungstage und eine finanzielle Förderung für ärztliche Fortbildungen sind bei uns eine Selbstverständlichkeit

  • Vereinbarkeit mit der Familie: Keine Pflicht-Dienste und 35 Tage Urlaub (inkl. Fortbildungstagen) - zudem bestehen Möglichkeiten für Teilzeitmodelle und (bei Interesse) Videosprechstunden im Home-Office

IHRE AUFGABEN:

  • Sie fokussieren sich auf die Patientenversorgung und bringen sich als Teil des Praxisteams ein

IHR PROFIL:

  • Sie verfügen über eine abgeschlossene Facharztausbildung der Allgemeinmedizin oder Inneren Medizin

  • Sie konnten (idealerweise) erste Erfahrungen im niedergelassenen Bereich sammeln

  • Sie haben (idealerweise) bereits hausärztlich relevante Fortbildungen oder Zusatzbezeichnungen absolviert (z.B. Psychosomatische Grundversorgung, Diabetologie, Hypertensiologie, Palliativmedizin)

Über PraxisEins

PraxisEins ist ein staatlich unterstützter Gesundheitsversorger mit einem Fokus auf den Bereichen der hausärztlichen Versorgung, Diabetologie und Schmerztherapie.

Unsere Mission

Versorgung sichern - Qualitätsmedizin gewährleisten. Als PraxisEins wollen wir die Primärversorgung zukunftsfähig machen – mit digitaler Unterstützung, klaren Prozessen und einem Umfeld, in dem Ärztinnen und Ärzte Medizin wieder mit Freude ausüben können!

PraxisEins ist ein Arbeitgeber, der Chancengleichheit fördert und Vielfalt schätzt. Wir freuen uns über alle Bewerbungen und bearbeiten diese völlig unabhängig von Geschlecht, Religionszugehörigkeit, Hautfarbe, Herkunft, sexueller Orientierung, Alter, Familienstand oder Behindertenstatus. Zur besseren Lesbarkeit wird in dieser Stellenanzeige das generische Maskulinum verwendet.

  • Alongside short-term delivery, you also keep long-term technical topics in view, including architecture, maintainability, security, technical debt, and the continuous improvement of our engineering standards.

This goes far beyond AI-assisted coding: you identify opportunities to integrate AI into research, technical conception, architecture, project planning, development, testing, reviews, debugging, documentation, and other development processes, and help the team use these tools effectively.


Your profile

  • You have at least 5 years of relevant professional experience in or around software development and have worked hands-on as a software developer yourself.

title: Werkstudent Data QA & Algorithm Benchmarking (m/w/d)
description:
Deine Mission

syte benutzt komplexe Algorithmen, die auf Basis von 3D-Punktwolken und 3D-Modellen Gebäudemetriken ausrechnen. Typische Beispiele für relevante Metriken sind Geschossfläche, Anzahl Geschosse, Volumen und Gebäudehöhen. Um schnelle Entwicklungszyklen zu gewährleisten, und Änderungen an den Algorithmen auf Knopfdruck quantitativ und automatisiert bewerten zu können, ist syte auf hochwertige QA-Daten angewiesen. Um diesen Datensatz systematisch auszubauen und zu härten und damit die Grundlage, auf der unsere Algorithmen gemessen werden, zu entwickeln, suchen wir dich als Werkstudent Data QA & Algorithm Benchmarking (m/w/d) zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt in Münster. 

Deine Aufgaben

  • Ground Truth Audit: Du evaluierst die Korrektheit bestehender Testdaten und ermittelst hierfür neue Metriken, die wir zur Evaluation unserer Algorithmen verwenden können.
  • Edge Cases jagen: Du ermittelst neue Testdaten für schwierige Gebäude (z.B. komplexe Dachformen, Bäume über den Dächern) und integrierst diese in den Gesamtdatensatz.
  • Data Sourcing: Du ermittelst potenzielle Quellen für neue Testdatensätze und integrierst diese möglichst automatisiert.
  • Benchmarking & Insights: Du führst unsere Benchmarking-Pipelines aus, um sowohl die Algorithmen als auch die Qualität der Daten quantitativ zu bewerten. Die Ergebnisse dieser Analysen visualisierst und kommunizierst du verständlich, sodass sich daraus Handlungsempfehlungen ableiten.
  • Pipeline Engineering: Du implementierst und testest Verbesserungen in den Benchmarking-Pipelines und den Parametern der Algorithmen.


Dein Profil

  • Dein Studium: Du studierst in einem höheren Bachelorsemester oder ersten Mastersemester (Geo-/Wirtschafts-)Informatik oder hast einen Schwerpunkt in Data Science/Statistik. Du hast auch einen gültigen Immatrikulationsnachweis. 
  • Analytische Fähigkeiten: Du arbeitest dich gerne tief in Daten ein und begeisterst dich für die statistische Analyse der Daten.
  • Neugierde für die komplexe Daten: Dir gefällt die Arbeit an und das Nachvollziehen von komplexeren Algorithmen in einer anspruchsvollen Domäne.
  • Teamfähigkeit: Du arbeitest mit hohem Qualitätsanspruch und kannst dich gut im Team koordinieren.
  • Sprachkenntnisse: Du sprichst verhandlungssicheres Deutsch (mind. C1) und fließend Englisch (mind. B2).

  • Einsatzort: Münster (ca. 1 Tag pro Woche im Office)

Deine Benefits

  • Dein attraktives Gehalt: Wir sorgen dafür, dass jeder Aspekt deiner Reise bei syte motivierend ist. Wir kennen deinen Wert!

  • Deine Hardware: Unser syte-Team ist mit modernster Hard- und Software ausgestattet.

description:

  • You don't record knowledge in traditional documentation, but rather as an AI-compatible knowledge base that is created concurrently while building – so that users can navigate more easily and the next agentic loop can build upon it more autonomously.

title: Chief Operating & Growth Officer (gn)

Die Aufgabe

Du übernimmst die Verantwortung für die wertschöpfenden Bereiche des Unternehmens und gestaltest die nächste Wachstumsphase maßgeblich mit:

Uns interessiert Deine unternehmerische Haltung mehr als ein bestimmter Lebenslauf. Umsetzungsverantwortung in einer relevanten Funktion (insbesondere Growth, Operations, E-Commerce) bei einem Unternehmen mit eigenem physischem Produkt, für die diese Rolle der nächste Karriereschritt nach vorne ist.

Was für uns zählt:

  • Unternehmerische Haltung & Ergebnisorientierung: über mehrere Jahre gewachsene (Teil-)Verantwortung für Wachstum und P&L, Freude an Umsetzung und Ownership, Zug zum Ergebnis.

Deine Chance

Eine echte unternehmerische Aufgabe mit voller Gestaltungsfreiheit und erheblichem Entwicklungspotenzial. Du arbeitest eng mit den Gesellschaftern zusammen und wirst am Erfolg beteiligt. description:

🚀 EverAI — Building the Future of AI Companionship

One of the Top 15 Largest & Fastest-Growing AI Companies in the World

50 Million Users in 2 years — Help Us Reach 100M first, 500M next

Our flagship product is the world’s largest AI companionship platform, redefining relationships for millions. It is governed by our proprietary moderation system, EverGuard — an internal AI designed to ensure everything we build is safe, ethical, and human-first.

And we’re only just getting started!

Our Team

We are an enthusiastic, passionate and hardworking team of ≈ 100 people. Our founding team has strong entrepreneurial experience building and scaling web products from 0 to IPO.

Alexis Soulopoulos [CEO]

• 10+ years in Tech Executive Leadership

• Co-Founder Mad Paws Holdings (from 0 to IPO)

Thomas Lacroix [Co-founder & CMO]

• 8+ years in Customer Acquisition & E-commerce Growth

• Serial-entrepreneur: Curatible (sold to Blackstone) and MTK Digital (exited / 0->$20m revenue)

Maruša Fasano [CFO/Legal]

• 25+ years in Finance, Strategy, M&A

• Ex-CFO/M&A @Curatible (exited to Blackstone)

• Ex-President of the Board @SotremoSA (exited)

• Co-founder/CFO @SoftOne (exited)

Your Role

You will report to and work closely with our Chief Marketing Officer (CMO), playing a key, hands-on role in the execution and optimization of our high-volume paid acquisition channels.

This is a fast-paced learning environment where you will execute the end-to-end User Acquisition process, from campaign setup and creative iteration to data analysis and reporting. You will have autonomy in your day-to-day execution, with continuous guidance and feedback from the team and senior leadership to accelerate your growth. Your ideas and analytical contributions will be actively sought to improve channel performance.

Your Responsibilities

Campaign Execution and Scaling Support:

  • Assist in the daily management of core paid acquisition channels or DSPs (e.g. Meta, TikTok, Google, etc.)

  • Support the creation of scalable acquisition funnels by ensuring proper tracking implementation and gathering data insights

  • Actively participate in the testing loop by preparing new ad concepts, organizing creative assets, and setting up audience tests

Performance Analysis and Reporting:

  • Monitor campaign and funnel performance using our core tools (Voluum, GA4, internal dashboards) and promptly flag any critical changes or performance anomalies

  • Pull, clean, and organize performance data (CPA, ROAS, retention) to support weekly and monthly strategic reviews

  • Maintain and update internal reporting documents and dashboards

Creative & Funnel Contribution:

  • Support the creative briefing process by gathering performance data and communicating required asset changes and successful angles to the content team

  • Collaborate with Product and Content teams to assist in the launch and testing cycles for landing pages, focusing on conversion rate improvements

  • Assist in documenting and implementing systems designed to streamline creative testing speed and reduce fatigue

Partnership Management & Learning:

  • Build initial rapport with key traffic source representatives, assisting the Senior team in managing communications and reporting performance

  • Research and document potential new acquisition opportunities (networks, formats, tools, etc.)

  • Stay up-to-date on platform rules, policy changes, and algorithm shifts

Challenges You’ll Tackle

In this role, you will be instrumental in supporting our growth goals. Specifically, you will:

  • Help us scale fast: Execute the daily campaign changes needed to grow our budgets while constantly watching the data to keep our cost targets (CAC/ROAS) in check

  • Grow our user base: Your analysis and execution will directly contribute to hitting our goal of growing from 40 million to 100 million users

  • Launch new channels: Handle the foundational setup (tracking, ad setup) required to successfully test and launch completely new advertising platforms

  • Improve conversions: Run A/B tests on landing pages and funnels to find opportunities to make our campaigns more efficient

  • Be the link for creative: Take performance data, translate it into clear suggestions for our creative team, and ensure the new ad concepts are launched and tracked correctly

Your Qualifications

Hard Skills

  • Experience level: Minimum 1 year of experience required in performance marketing or user acquisition

  • Platform curiosity: You have explored and understand the basic structures of major ad platforms (like Meta, TikTok, Google, etc.)

  • Technical aptitude: Ability to quickly learn and master new software, dashboards, and platform interfaces

  • Analytical & Creative ability: You have a good eye for what makes an ad hook effective, and you possess strong analytical skills (comfortable with data/Excel) to learn how to translate data into creative briefs

Nice-to-Haves

  • Knowledge of basic online marketing metrics (CPM, CTR, CPA)

  • Familiarity with any analytics or tracking tool (e.g., GA4, Voluum, or basic platform reporting setups)

  • Experience in sensitive or regulated verticals (e.g. dating, femtech, telehealth, etc.)

Soft Skills

🗣 Good communication skills: You are fluent in English and can clearly articulate thoughts and findings

🎯 Driven & Accountable: You are motivated, take full ownership of your tasks, and commit to achieving goals

⚡️ Action-oriented: You thrive in a fast-paced environment and prioritize execution and speed

🧠 Curious & Detail-oriented: You are meticulous with data and possess a strong desire to learn the why behind performance

🧢 Humble learner: You actively seek feedback and are eager to grow in the field of paid acquisition

Why EverAI?

📈 Exponential Growth: From 50M users in 2 years, to 100M next — and 500M beyond

🚀 Track Record of Category-Creating Innovation: We consistently launch world-first AI applications — setting the pace, not following it

🌍 Global Impact: Top-tier user growth, real-world adoption, and cultural relevance

🧠 Proven Leadership: A senior team that’s launched, scaled, and exited & IPO’d multiple scale ups — now fully focused on reshaping AI companionship

👥 Elite Remote Team: 100% remote and built to win — world-class talent from Tier 1 tech companies, with a culture of ownership, velocity, and radical creativity

🛡️ Ethical Core: Our AI ecosystem is governed by EverGuard, our proprietary AI moderation technology, ensuring responsible development at scale

What We Offer

✍️ Contract Type: We prefer B2B, but we’re flexible, what matters is long-term commitment and impact
📍 Work From Anywhere: Fully remote. Choose the environment where you do your best work
🏝️ Paid Time Off: 4 weeks (20 working days) of PTO per year to recharge and reset
👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Annual Gathering: A yearly in-person meetup to connect, brainstorm, and celebrate wins together
❤️‍🩹 Health & Wellness Support: Monthly allowance of 100 USD for health insurance expenses & access to unlimited 1:1 sessions with psychologists and lifestyle experts through OpenUp (also available to up to three of your family members)
🏢 Co-Working Space Budget: Work from a co-working space up to twice per month (35 EUR / 40 USD per visit) to stay inspired and connected
📚 Learning Budget: Dedicated funds to support your professional growth: courses, books, conferences, events, or certifications
💻 Company Laptop & Equipment: Laptop provided + monitor budget up to 250 USD + keyboard/mouse/mic/headphones budget up to 150 USD
⚡ AI Tools Access: Premium access to ChatGPT, Cursor, Hugging Face, Claude Code, and any other tool needed to excel at your job, power your ideas and workflows

* 💸 Compensation: Our salary ranges are set based on role level, scope, location, and market data, and applied consistently regardless of candidate background or negotiation history. The final offer within the published range reflects assessed experience and scope.

🎯 Top Tier Talent Is Our Multiplier

We’re a fully remote group of A-players from Tier 1 tech, led by an exec team who’ve launched, scaled, and exited multiple companies. We move fast, and care deeply about what we build — and who we build it with.

We’re looking for exceptional talent ready to ship & distribute world-first AI products at scale, fast, and co-create with us this category-defining business.

title: Global Solutions Architect - Cloud

description:
Head of Migrations

Location: Our offices are in Central London, along with several of our customers. Travel to our customer sites is required, the frequency of which will vary from customer-to-customer. You need to be able to travel onsite to London up to 3 days per week, although onsite requirements will vary week-to-week and customer-to-customer from 0 to 3 days.

Salary: Competitive (DOE)

 

Defence/SC Clearance Requirements:

SC clearance is required for our customer facing teams. You do not need active SC clearance as we will undertake checks upon you joining, but you must be eligible to pass SC clearance. DV clearance may be required for certain roles, so the ability/willingness to pass DV clearance is advantageous but not essential.

About the role

We are hiring a Head of Migrations to lead all migration work across the business. You will be the single accountable owner of our migration pipeline, created in direct response to the volume of AWS Migration Acceleration Programme (MAP) engagements now running across our client base.

The remit goes wider than MAP workload migrations. You will lead data centre exit programmes and landing zone migrations too, building a repeatable set of methodologies and delivery assets for each rather than running every engagement bespoke.

This is a role that grows with the offering. You start by proving demand and defining how we deliver. Once the investment case lands, you recruit and lead the team. In time you own a standalone unit with full profit and loss accountability. The person does not change as the offering matures. What changes is what you are accountable for.

What you will do

  • Own Cloudscaler's MAP relationship, making sure engagements are registered, funded and tracked through Assess, Mobilise and Migrate, with funding claims that are accurate, evidenced and defensible.

  • Lead data centre exit programmes end to end, from estate discovery and dependency mapping through to decommissioning and contract exit.

  • Own our end-to-end migration methodology: portfolio discovery, application assessment using the 7 Rs, wave planning, execution and post-migration validation.

  • Own the migration assessment tooling as subject-matter expert, defining what it captures, how findings map to migration patterns, and how a business case is built from the output.

  • Support the commercial team on proposals, workshops and MAP funding conversations, and build trusted adviser relationships with client CTOs and infrastructure leads.

  • Deliver against a six-month revenue plan, report monthly KPIs from month one, and build the investment case for a ring fenced team.

  • Recruit, lead and develop that team once the case is approved, working to a team gross profit model.

  • Drive AI and automation across the migration lifecycle to cut manual effort and improve the accuracy of migration business cases.

  • Represent Cloudscaler publicly through speaking, blogs, white papers and partnership activity with AWS.

What we are looking for

  • Proven leadership of large-scale AWS migration programmes, with real accountability for outcomes.

  • Working knowledge of AWS MAP, including funding, credits and the evidencing discipline the programme demands.

  • Experience of data centre exit and landing zone migration, not just application moves.

  • The ability to build a TCO model and a migration business case that convinces both an architect and a board.

  • Commercial fluency: revenue, gross profit, utilisation and pipeline are part of the job, not someone else's problem.

  • Credibility with senior client stakeholders and a track record of building trust through delivery.

  • Experience hiring and leading delivery teams, and setting the standard for quality.

  • Comfort working without an established playbook. You will write it.

  • Taking an organisation through AWS competency attainment.

  • Regulated sector experience: financial services, public sector, utilities, healthcare or defence.

  • Modernisation delivery, including containerisation and server-less refactoring.

  • P&L ownership for a practice or business unit.

title: Software Engineer (Data)
description:
Our Mission

We’re not your average benefits platform – we’re the driving force that uplifts people’s lives. Our technology connects the entire benefits ecosystem, creating better outcomes for employers, employees, brokers, and providers.

Our mission is clear: to build a world where everything works at its best, ensuring every employee gets the support they need to thrive—both at work and beyond.

Your Mission

As our Software Engineer (Data), you’ll build and run the pipelines, orchestration, and infrastructure that move data across Ben: in from our product and the tools we use, in from our customers, and back out to them again. It’s the plumbing the whole company and our customers depend on, and it has to stay reliable. We serve global enterprise customers with strict security and reliability requirements.

You’ll own real work from day one. You’ll have a strong team of cross functional engineers alongside you, room to grow into harder problems, and the freedom to do the job your way.

What you’ll be working on

  • Own everything that flows into Ben: build and maintain the ingestion pipelines that bring data into our warehouse, with Fivetran for managed sources and custom pipelines where we need them.

  • Keep everything running on time: own the orchestration that keeps data moving on schedule and recovers cleanly when something breaks.

  • Scale and manage our data infrastructure: build and manage our data infrastructure as code with Terraform, using mainly AWS services.

  • Connect Ben to every system our customers run: build enterprise-grade pipelines and connectors for our customers, bringing their data in, for example from HR and payroll systems, and getting accurate data back out to them, reliably and securely, even at the volumes large customers bring.

  • Build the data layer our agents act on: help connect our data to the AI agents and services we're building, including through MCP connectors, so they get the right context at the right time.

  • Shape what we build: work with product and other stakeholders to scope problems and agree on simple but scalable solutions.

  • Build it to enterprise standard: build to current security practice, for example the OWASP Top 10 and the AWS Well-Architected Framework.

Behind the scenes

Ben runs on Python 3, Django, PostgreSQL, and React, on AWS.

Our data platform today is built around Fivetran, AWS DMS or custom pipelines for ingestion, dbt for transformation, PostgreSQL on AWS RDS as the warehouse, and n8n or AWS Lambda for automation between systems. We manage our infrastructure as code with Terraform and use different AWS services depending on requirements.

We have adopted frontier level agentic development practices and continue to push the envelope of what’s possible with current technologies.

  • Strong experience with Python and SQL.

  • A few years building and running production data pipelines that other people relied on.

  • Comfortable with infrastructure as code, ideally Terraform, and hands-on with AWS, for example Lambda, ECS, Glue, S3, RDS.

  • A good grasp of ETL/ELT and orchestration.

  • Experience building or running data integrations and connectors, especially ones that other companies or customers depend on, is a real plus.

  • Solid software engineering fundamentals: clean code, sensible design, and tests you can rely on.

  • You keep security in mind when you build applications and configure infrastructure, and you know what enterprise customers expect of their data.

Nice to have, not essential:

  • Experience working on customer-facing data integrations such as HRIS or payroll feeds via SFTP and in EDI format

  • Experience with MCP server development, or different ways of preparing data for AI agents such as ontology modelling, context, knowledge graphs, and semantic layers.

We don't expect all of it. We do expect curiosity about it.

Why join us?

Ben's customers are large enterprise employers, and the hundreds of thousands of people who work for them rely on us to get their benefits right, every time. That depends on data moving accurately between their systems and ours, every cycle. You get to work on the data infrastructure that makes this run like clockwork.

At the same time, Ben is an AI-native organisation. Agents are already doing a lot of impactful work here, and they can only do it on data they can trust. That raises questions a dashboard never had to answer. How fresh does this need to be for an agent to act on it? How do you match the same entity across tools? How do you control what an agent is allowed to see? Very few engineers have answered those in production. You'd be one of them.

You'll take ownership of large, complex problem spaces, help design how they scale, and build an agentic layer few engineers have built anywhere yet, and you'll see the impact of it: Ben supports hundreds of thousands of people across 30+ countries.

Jedox is a global leader in Enterprise Performance Management (EPM) and a recognized Gartner Magic Quadrant Leader, helping organizations transform fragmented planning into connected, data-driven decision-making.

Trusted by more than 2,500 customers worldwide, Jedox enables business planning, budgeting and forecasting for finance, sales, and broader enterprise departments with leading-edge technology to outperform digital transformation and provide tangible customer value. At the heart of the platform is JedoxAI - a multi-agent intelligence engine delivering explainable, AI-powered forecasting, natural-language insights and AIssisted™ planning - putting Jedox at the forefront of the shift to AI-driven performance management.


Your Responsibilities

As a Sales Account Executive (m/f/d) within the Jedox team, you will play a key part in helping enterprise customers to transform their planning, forecasting and performance management processes. Acting as a trusted advisor, you will use a value-based sales approach to show how Jedox provides modern, digital and integrated enterprise performance and analysis (xP&A) solutions.

In this role, you will own the entire sales process for enterprise customers, from identifying potential clients to closing deals. You will promote Jedox as the ideal solution for xP&A initiatives, work closely with internal teams and develop long-term relationships with customers and partners, while maintaining a strong focus on value, trust and sustainable success.

We are building a high-performing team defined by ownership, accountability and energy. This is a genuinely exciting time to join: AI is reshaping how every finance team plans and forecasts, and Jedox is right at the centre of that conversation - giving you a fresh, differentiated story to take to market. If you're a motivated seller who enjoys being out in front of customers and partners, and want to make your mark in an exciting company, you'll find real support, momentum and opportunity here. You will own your number, your territory and your pipeline - creating opportunity rather than waiting for it, with a team around you that celebrates the wins together.

  • Own the end-to-end sales cycle: Generate revenue by adopting a value-selling approach throughout the process, from initial engagement to closing enterprise-level deals - with full personal accountability for every outcome in your territory.
  • Create and own high-quality pipeline: Build and maintain healthy pipeline coverage against your quota through proactive, self-generated prospecting - not just inbound - with disciplined weekly pipeline management in our CRM as the single source of truth.
  • Communicate the value of Jedox: Demonstrate how Jedox and JedoxAI empower xP&A projects and elevate planning, forecasting and business decisions - bringing AI-driven, explainable forecasting into the conversation and anchoring every discussion on business outcomes, not features.
  • Inspire digital transformation: Engage prospects by presenting a clear and compelling vision of digitisation and integrated business planning.
  • Develop strategic sales plans: Identify, prospect and execute targeted sales plays and activities to win enterprise customers, including structured account planning, rigorous qualification (e.g. MEDDPICC) and multi-threading across finance, IT and operations stakeholders.
  • Cross-functional collaboration: Acquire new customers by working closely with the pre-sales, channel management, marketing and business development teams - bringing colleagues and partners in early, and lifting each other up as one team with one number.
  • Drive market-facing activity: Contribute to workshops, webinars and events alongside marketing and partners to create demand and build visible expertise in your market.
  • Work smarter with AI: Actively use modern AI tools in your daily workflow - from account research and prospecting to preparing presentations, proposals and follow-ups - so more of your time goes where it counts: in front of customers and partners.
  • Own forecasting and pipeline management: Maintain accurate monthly and quarterly forecasts as well as pipeline reports, with strong CRM hygiene, and play an active role in prospecting activities.
  • Build lasting relationships: Build trusted partnerships with customers, partners and internal stakeholders to ensure long-term success.


Your Profile

  • Over three years' experience in professional sales, ideally within the FP&A function.
  • Experience in Enterprise Performance Management or in selling analytics, AI, data, or ERP solutions.
  • Strong record of success in achieving and exceeding sales goals.
  • Proven ability to build, manage and self-generate a healthy sales pipeline and expand existing accounts.
  • A high-ownership mindset: you act with urgency, take responsibility for your results, and when challenges arise you come with ideas on how to tackle them together.
  • Resilience and positivity: you're the kind of person who stays positive, keeps going and enjoys the journey as much as the win.
  • A love of being active in the market: you genuinely enjoy talking to customers and partners - on calls, in meetings and at events - and you know that's where great pipeline comes from.
  • Strong collaboration skills with a clear focus on customer success and innovation.
  • Confident, hands-on use of AI tools (such as Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot or similar) in your day-to-day selling - for example researching accounts, building presentations and business cases, sharpening messaging and working smarter across the sales cycle.
  • Native or fluent English skills; an established network and knowledge of the UK & Ireland enterprise market are a real advantage.


Transparency Note: Use of Artificial Intelligence

As a tech-driven company, Jedox uses modern technologies — including AI — to continuously improve our processes.
In recruiting, AI may support us in screening and structuring applications. It does not replace human judgment, but helps us reduce bias and ensure a consistent candidate experience. Your application is always reviewed by real people.

title: Senior Accountant
description:
Join us as we work to unlock the value of offshore wind! JERA Nex bp is a new joint venture between JERA, Japan’s largest power generation company, and bp, one of the world’s leading energy companies. Established to unlock the potential of offshore wind across the globe, our talented team, exciting pipeline and solid capital commitment give us the potential to become one of the world’s most successful offshore wind companies. 

We entered the market with a portfolio of operational and development assets, alongside the resources, capabilities and resilience to deliver offshore wind energy at scale. 

 

Why this role matters 

You will join the Accounting team and be part of the wider Finance department of JERA Nex bp. The team is made up of approximately 16 people working to deliver high quality and efficient accounting on a local standalone as well as consolidated group level for a multinational organisation.

Why you should join us:

  • Dynamic and experienced team with various backgrounds

  • Motivated to support JERA Nex bp’s offshore wind ambitions

  • Exposed to international deployment of renewable energy at a critical time for the energy transition

In this role you will: 

We are seeking an experienced Senior Accountant to take full ownership of end-to-end accounting for a portfolio of legal entities within the group. This is a hands-on, "a-z" role covering everything from transactional processing through statutory reporting and audit management.

 

Key Responsibilities

  • Own end-to-end accounting for assigned legal entities, including invoice posting/payments, accruals, month-end close and reconciliations

  • Prepare and analyze financial statements, ensuring accuracy and compliance with accounting standards.

  • Manage intercompany accounting, funding transactions, and acquisition-related bookkeeping

  • Ensure compliance with tax regulations and assist in the preparation of tax returns.

  • Support transfer pricing documentation and calculations

  • Perform payroll accounting and service invoice creation

  • Manage accounts receivable, cash management, and liquidity planning

  • Prepare UK statutory financial statements (UK GAAP) and support IFRS group reporting

  • Lead statutory audit management and support group audit requirements

  • Identify and drive process improvement and automation opportunities within the accounting function

  • Implement and maintain effective internal controls.


To be successful in the role you will bring: 

  • Master's degree in Finance, Accounting, or a comparable professional qualification (e.g., ACA, ACCA, CIMA)

  • 10+ years of experience in accounting, finance, or a related field

  • Strong proficiency in Excel and SAP S/4HANA

  • Solid working knowledge of IFRS and UK GAAP

  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills

  • Strong problem-solving ability and a proactive approach to process improvement/automation

  • Experience with VAT and CIT processes in a UK context is essential; transfer pricing exposure a plus

  • Detail-oriented with a high level of accuracy

  • Strong ethical standards and integrity.

What you can expect from us: 

Working at JERA Nex bp means being part of a global leader in offshore wind, where innovation, collaboration, and sustainability drive everything we do. You’ll enjoy: 

  • A collaborative and inclusive work culture, with space for team-building and social activities 

  • Flexible working hours and the opportunity to work from home, with regular in-person connection 

  • Opportunities for career growth and professional development in a fast-growing international company. 

 

As we build our company, we are driven by:  

Care for each other and our world – we leave egos at the door, are inclusive, collaborative and open to new ideas 

A spirit of ingenuity - we are pioneers and innovators making the impossible possible 

A commitment to unlocking value from offshore wind – we aim to make offshore wind sustainable, affordable and accessible to the countries & communities we serve. 

 

About JERA Nex bp 

JERA Nex bp is a purpose-built offshore wind company committed to unlocking the power of offshore wind by developing high-quality, competitive projects. 

A 50:50 joint venture between JERA Co. and bp, JERA Nex bp is an end-to-end developer, owner and operator with more than fifteen years of experience in operating offshore wind projects.  

Headquartered in London, with offices across Europe, Asia, and Australia, JERA Nex bp has a portfolio of operational and development projects across nine countries, and draws on a rich heritage of pioneering offshore wind in Asia Pacific and the North Sea.

title: EMEA Talent Acquisition Partner (R5549)
description:
Shield AI is a venture-backed defense-tech company with the mission of protecting service members and civilians with intelligent systems. Its products include Hivemind autonomy software, V-BAT and X-BAT aircraft, and Aechelon simulation and synthetic reality technologies. With offices and facilities across the U.S., Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific, Shield AI’s technology actively supports operations worldwide. For more information, visit www.shield.ai. Follow Shield AI on LinkedIn, X, Instagram, and YouTube. 

Job Description:

We’re hiring a  Strategic Talent Acquisition Partner to help power our next phase of growth across EMEA. This is a high-impact, business-critical role at the heart of Shield’s AI international expansion—supporting new market entries, building and scaling best-in-class  sales and engineering organisations, and partnering with senior leaders to shape our future. This is not a transactional recruiting role. You will operate as a strategic advisor, market expert, and builder—owning how talent enables scale across diverse EMEA markets.

What you'll do:
Strategic Talent Partnership
  • Partner closely with senior and executive-level stakeholders to understand business objectives, growth plans, and capability gaps.
  • Translate market entry and growth plan into scalable, data-driven regional talent acquisition strategies.
  • Act as a thought partner and advisor on talent trends, market intelligence, and competitive hiring strategies.
  • Advise leaders on market feasibility from a talent perspective (availability, cost, timing, and risk).
    • Execution with Excellence
  • Own the end-to-end recruitment lifecycle for all roles including senior, critical, and hard-to-hire roles.
  • Partner to design and execute sourcing strategies that attract high-impact engineering and commercial talent across the EMEA region
  • Shape local hiring approaches while maintaining a consistent global hiring bar.
    • Employer Branding & Talent Attraction
  • Act as an EMEA ambassador for our employer brand, ensuring we are positioned as an employer of choice in the region
  • Partner with Branding, Comms, and Leadership to shape and localise our employer value proposition for different EMEA countries.
  • Identify and activate employer branding opportunities (events, content,
    communities, referrals, social presence).
  • Ensure inclusive, consistent, and authentic candidate experience that reinforces our brand and values at every touchpoint.
    • Driving at Scale
  • Use data to forecast hiring needs, track progress, and continuously optimise our recruitment performance.
  • Improve TA processes, tools, and ways of partnering to support speed, quality, and scale.
  • Be a visible voice for talent across the EMEA leadership community.

    • Required qualifications:
  • Proven experience as a strategic talent acquisition partner driving full cycle hiring for both engineering and go to market talent within the defence space or Public Sector Saas space.
  • Demonstrated success supporting new market entries and scaling teams at pace.
  • Strong credibility working with senior leaders and executives as a trusted talent advisor and business partner.
  • Deep understanding of EMEA talent dynamics, sourcing strategies, and competitive intelligence.
  • Highly consultative, commercially minded, and comfortable operating with ambiguity.
  • Ability to balance strategic thinking with hands-on execution.

title: Applied AI Senior Consultant
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Applied AI Senior Consultant based in United Kingdom.

This is a senior, client-facing consulting role focused on turning emerging AI capabilities into practical business outcomes in healthcare.
You will help health plans and payer organizations identify, design, and scale AI-powered solutions across critical operational workflows.
The role combines strategic advisory, hands-on solution design, and delivery leadership from early discovery through production deployment.
You will work directly with executives, operational leaders, technology teams, and external partners to solve complex challenges.
Your work may span utilization management, claims processing, care management, member services, and administrative operations.
You will also help establish responsible AI practices that address privacy, security, compliance, governance, and human oversight.
This opportunity is ideal for an experienced AI consultant who can bridge business needs, technical possibilities, and measurable value.


Accountabilities
  • Serve as a trusted AI advisor to healthcare clients and payer organizations, helping leadership teams identify high-value opportunities for AI and automation.
  • Lead discovery sessions and solution-design workshops that translate operational challenges into practical, achievable AI use cases and adoption roadmaps.
  • Guide AI initiatives from strategy and use-case identification through pilots, solution implementation, production deployment, optimization, and continuous improvement.
  • Design and deliver AI-powered solutions for payer workflows, including utilization management, claims processing, care management, member engagement, member services, and administrative operations.
  • Develop solutions incorporating large language models, retrieval-augmented generation, workflow automation, copilots, and agentic AI orchestration where appropriate.
  • Define solution architectures that integrate AI capabilities responsibly with existing client systems, technologies, and operating environments.
  • Establish governance models, human-in-the-loop controls, safeguards, and responsible AI practices for regulated healthcare environments.
  • Evaluate AI platforms, technologies, and vendors based on business value, implementation feasibility, security, compliance, scalability, and return on investment.
  • Create reusable frameworks, accelerators, and delivery approaches that can be applied consistently across multiple consulting engagements.
  • Coordinate cross-functional delivery teams and technology vendors throughout solution design, implementation, and operationalization.
  • Support business development and pre-sales activities, including client presentations, prospect discussions, solution development, and RFP responses.
  • Help expand AI capabilities and offerings by identifying emerging technologies, partnerships, market opportunities, and areas for differentiation.
  • Define success metrics for AI initiatives, monitor outcomes, and communicate progress and business impact to technical, operational, and executive stakeholders.
  • Stay current with advances in AI, payer-industry trends, responsible AI practices, and relevant healthcare regulatory developments.

    • Requirements

    • Bachelor’s degree in a relevant discipline or equivalent practical experience, with 8+ years of experience in technology consulting, digital transformation, solution delivery, or a related field.
    • Significant recent experience applying AI in production environments, with a proven track record of moving beyond prototypes and proofs of concept into deployed solutions.
    • Direct experience working with health plans, payers, managed-care organizations, or related healthcare operations.
    • Strong understanding of payer workflows such as utilization management, claims processing, care management, member engagement, member services, or administrative operations.
    • Practical expertise with large language models, retrieval-augmented generation, workflow automation, copilots, and agentic AI patterns.
    • Experience designing and implementing AI solutions in regulated environments, with a strong understanding of privacy, security, HIPAA compliance, reliability, governance, and responsible AI.
    • Proven ability to connect complex business challenges with practical AI opportunities and translate strategy into executable solutions.
    • Strong solution architecture and delivery skills, including the ability to integrate AI technologies with enterprise systems and operational environments.
    • Experience advising executive stakeholders and communicating complex technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
    • Experience supporting consulting business development, pre-sales activities, client presentations, solution development, or RFP responses.
    • Demonstrated ability to coordinate cross-functional teams, technology partners, and external vendors throughout complex initiatives.
    • Strong strategic thinking, problem-solving, stakeholder management, and communication skills.
    • Comfortable operating independently in a client-facing environment while maintaining a strong focus on delivery quality, business value, and measurable outcomes.

      • Benefits

      • Opportunity to work on high-impact AI initiatives within the healthcare and payer ecosystem.
      • Client-facing consulting environment with significant exposure to executive, operational, and technology stakeholders.
      • Opportunity to lead initiatives across the full AI lifecycle, from strategy and discovery through production deployment and optimization.
      • Fully remote work arrangement within the United States.
      • Contractor or FTE engagement structure, depending on the position and arrangement.
      • Opportunity to contribute to responsible AI practices involving privacy, security, HIPAA compliance, governance, and human oversight.
      • Exposure to emerging technologies including generative AI, retrieval-augmented generation, workflow automation, copilots, and agentic AI.
      • Professional growth through complex digital transformation engagements and opportunities to develop reusable AI frameworks and capabilities.
      • Collaborative environment spanning strategy, engineering, technology, delivery, compliance, and commercial functions.
